build_hypothesis.hypothesis: A deterministic OpenUSD asset using the official 25-35 coordinates, nominal shell-25 interface dimensions, five N-position keys/keyways and a separate coupling nut can represent this unknown-manufacturer J599 pair without reusing or modifying the old 61-contact asset.
build_hypothesis.unique_change: Create files only under the isolated J599 directory.
build_hypothesis.expected_result: Visual and assembly USD layers contain 128 correctly indexed pin/socket pairs, five compatible keys/keyways, distinct plug/body/nut rigid-body roles and explicit provenance metadata.
build_hypothesis.failure_criterion: Any old path changes, missing/duplicate contact IDs, wrong pin/socket roles, non-positive nominal key clearance, or generated USD that cannot be opened by the Isaac runtime.

static_validation_hypothesis.hypothesis: The generated asset and contract are internally consistent before an Isaac process is started.
static_validation_hypothesis.unique_change: No geometry change during validation; read-only checks only.
static_validation_hypothesis.expected_result: All static acceptance fields in config/model_contract.json pass and contacts remain visual-only.
static_validation_hypothesis.failure_criterion: Any count, coordinate, role, key-clearance, thread-relation, collision-role or authorization check fails.

dynamic_validation_hypotheses.hypothesis: With N keys aligned, an explicit no-hand prismatic/revolute test fixture can insert and tighten the two connector bodies in Isaac Sim while collisions remain active.
dynamic_validation_hypotheses.unique_change: Run the nominal aligned test scene in one fresh Isaac process.
dynamic_validation_hypotheses.expected_result: The plug reaches the defined final face plane, the nut completes the commanded turn, the 7.62 mm/rev relation stays within contract tolerance, and the hold remains stable.
dynamic_validation_hypotheses.failure_criterion: Final-depth, screw-relation, hold-drift, solver-error or post-start-pose-write gate fails.

dynamic_validation_hypotheses.hypothesis: A 3 degree yaw error causes a real five-key/keyway collision and prevents false full insertion under a bounded connector-only force fixture.
dynamic_validation_hypotheses.unique_change: Run a fresh, independent five-key negative case at 3 degrees yaw with the numerically unstable blocked-thread proxy isolated and an explicit 7.83 N prismatic force limit.
dynamic_validation_hypotheses.expected_result: The plug remains above the contract wrong-key stop threshold and cannot be reported assembled.
dynamic_validation_hypotheses.failure_criterion: The wrong-key case reaches the nominal final plane or the collider/solver evidence is unavailable.

dynamic_correction_history.observation: A five-second velocity command reached and held the metal stop, but continued nut rotation produced a 10.37 mm terminal screw-relation error.
A 377.95 degree revolute position target was interpreted modulo one turn and moved only 0.230 mm, while the free-motion screw relation remained accurate to 1.25 micrometers.

dynamic_correction_history.unique_change: Use the original velocity drive only for the 756 steps computed from 8 mm travel, 7.62 mm/rev lead, 120 deg/s, and 240 Hz; then command zero velocity for the fixed hold.
dynamic_correction_history.expected_result: The aligned plug reaches the metal stop without accumulating post-stop nut over-rotation, and terminal screw-relation error remains within 0.25 mm.
dynamic_correction_history.failure_criterion: The final face, hold, metal-stop, screw-relation, solver, or no-pose-write gate fails.

dynamic_correction_history.observation: The 3 degree plug stopped at z=7.239 mm with 12064 wrong-key contact samples and no metal-stop contact, but the 0.12 N m drive caused the rack proxy to slip after blockage.

dynamic_correction_history.unique_change: Reduce the common maximum nut-drive torque from 0.12 N m to 0.0095 N m, equivalent to at most 7.83 N axial screw force at the 7.62 mm lead; keep geometry, yaw cases, timing, speed, and gates unchanged.
dynamic_correction_history.expected_result: The aligned case still reaches the stop, while wrong-key contact reacts the bounded drive without rack-proxy slip beyond the 0.25 mm screw-relation tolerance.
dynamic_correction_history.failure_criterion: Either the aligned revalidation fails or the wrong-key terminal screw-relation error remains above 0.25 mm.

dynamic_correction_history.observation: The lower torque retained the physical key block but did not stabilize the deliberately jammed rack proxy, so thread-relation evidence from a wrong-key jam is invalid.

dynamic_correction_history.unique_change: For the wrong-key case only, do not author the rack coupling; drive the existing prismatic fixture toward full insertion with a 7.83 N force cap. Keep the nominal threaded assembly case unchanged.
dynamic_correction_history.expected_result: The 3 degree plug produces labelled key/keyway contacts, remains above z=1.5 mm, never touches the metal stop, and holds without solver errors or pose writes.
dynamic_correction_history.failure_criterion: Any key collision, depth, metal-stop, solver, finite-state, or no-pose-write gate fails.
